target_contract.states: Closed → independent lab/scenario loading → readable or retryable read errors; POST disables controls then restores result/error; close/pagehide invalidates request ownership; no automatic POST retry.
target_contract.data_effects: Server public reports are authoritative. Generation plus per-kind sequence suppresses stale success/errors; 45s client timeout aborts waiting, not server execution. Evidence read uses fixed same-origin path and Blob URL cleanup.
target_contract.semantics_accessibility: Native dialog with labelled title/description, labelled select, named buttons, details/summary, role=status and role=alert; initial/trapped/return focus and conditional lost-focus recovery need native and assistive revalidation.
target_contract.styling_layout: Scope all styles to frontier classes; important auto dialog margin resists global reset; direct-child footer specificity resists page footer rules; 390px single-column controls/cards preserve background and internal scroll.
target_contract.performance_lifecycle: Use lightweight verified /lab projection; full trace read only on explicit evidence action; bounded display arrays/raw preview and 45s timers; clear pending requests/timers on close/pagehide. Measure real long-session memory/layout performance separately.
target_contract.security_privacy: No arbitrary code, paths or model keys submitted; unsafe content uses textContent, evidence_url fixed; UI.json supplies configured access token. Backend scenario whitelist, concurrency and S1 signature/nonce enforce trust; production tenant acceptance remains separate.
target_contract.observability: Show read/execution failures without claiming success; distinguish source report digest from projection digest, declare scope and unknowns, retain actual process calls and independent result counts.
target_contract.integration: Six HTML imports yield sixteen registered parent contexts; hash navigation must not duplicate triggers or remove original pages. Actual user research bridge stays read-only and opens this separate experimental surface explicitly.
